mechanism: Voriconazole inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2D6, reducing fluphenazine metabolism and increasing plasma concentrations, while both drugs prolong QT interval and have anticholinergic effects.
action: Monitor QT interval via ECG, consider fluphenazine dose reduction, monitor for increased extrapyramidal symptoms and anticholinergic toxicity; ensure adequate renal/hepatic function assessment.
